Name: Tap
Desc: Select a color to remove 1 unit from all cubes of that color.

Name: Code Extermination
Desc: Choose any area and clear all cubes in that row once

Name: Refine
Desc: Choose a color and divide all cubes of that color into 1-unit cubes.

Name: Deadline Rescue
Desc: Gain 2 turns after use

Name: Swap
Desc: Choose any 2 rows and swap their locations.

Name: Domain Recovery
Desc: Choose any 2 adjacent cubes and swap their locations

Name: Freeze
Desc: Freeze the ascending bar once. No cubes will be ascended starting the next round (This effect can be stacked up to 3 times.)

Name: Directed Movement
Desc: Choose any area and snap all cubes in that row in the chosen direction.

Name: Random Function α
Desc: Randomly select a color and apply a random effect to it. (Random effects: Structural Adjustment, Data Simplification, Parameter Inflation, and Filter Inflation)

Name: Random Function β
Desc: Randomly select a column and apply a random effect to it. (Random effects: Code Extermination, Sequence Reset, and Directed Movement)

Name: Purify
Desc: Randomly purifies 1 Red Wave, Blue Wave, or Green Wave Cube (no effect if none exists).

Name: Parameter Inflation
Desc: Choose a color and add 8 units to all cubes of that color.

Name: Hatch
Desc: Select a color to fill empty adjacent spaces around all matching cubes with 1-unit cubes, until they hit other cubes.

Name: Ultima Slash
Desc: Slash once where the Sword Mark is.

Name: Super Tap
Desc: Remove 1 unit from all normal cubes of any color.

Name: Super Hatch
Desc: Fill empty adjacent spaces around all normal cubes with matching 1-unit cubes, until they hit other cubes.

Name: Super Refine
Desc: Divide all existing normal cubes into 1-unit cubes.

Name: Double Row Clear
Desc: Choose any 2 rows and clear all cubes in them once.

Name: Super Freeze
Desc: Freeze the ascending bar 3 times. No cubes will be ascended starting the next turn (This effect can be stacked up to 3 times.)

Name: Super Purify
Desc: Purifies all Red Wave, Blue Wave, and Green Wave Cubes (no effect if none exist).
